SKIING IN SKYRIM @VERSION@

Strap on a pair of skis and ski Skyrim's mountains: carve, skid, tuck, skate
across the flats, hit jumps and tumble when you get it wrong.

Player only. Built for a controller; keyboard and mouse work but are rougher.

REQUIREMENTS
- Skyrim SE or AE. Built and tested on 1.6.640, but it uses CommonLibSSE-NG
  and Address Library, so it should work on any version they support:
  Steam 1.5.97 through 1.7.104, and GOG 1.6.659 and 1.6.1179. VR is not
  supported.
- SKSE matching your game version.
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins.
- SKSE Menu Framework (settings menu).
- Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64).

Recommended: True Directional Movement. While you ski, the mod takes over
your facing from it.

INSTALLATION
Install the archive with your mod manager and enable SkiingInSkyrim.esp
(ESL-flagged, it doesn't use a load order slot). The source archive on the
same page is not a mod install.

Safe to install or uninstall at any time: it adds no scripts and saves
nothing into your save game, so it's worth just trying out. Uninstalling
only removes the skis from your inventory; settings stay in the INI.

GETTING STARTED
Craft Wooden Skis at a forge (firewood and leather strips) and wear them:
skiing turns on while they're worn. Take them off to walk.

Controls (controller):
- Left stick: steer, relative to the camera. Push firmly the way the skis
  point to tuck.
- Triggers: edge left and right. The skis carve an arc that tightens with
  more edge.
- On gentle ground, push forward and squeeze the triggers alternately to
  skate.
Keyboard and mouse: W/A/S/D steer, the mouse buttons edge.

Everything is in the SKSE Menu Framework menu under Skiing in Skyrim:
speed, body, camera, stamina and impact settings, plus a Compatibility
section that shows which related mods were found.

Crashes into trees, rocks and walls, and landing flat from a big air, hurt
and can throw you into a tumble. Landing along a slope, or in powder, is
soft.
